decisions.decision: Consensus to strike section 4.15.K and write a new 4.15.G setting minimum acreage and reasonable buffers.
Consensus that chemical odor masking products would not be permitted in marijuana applications.
decisions.quote: consensus was to add that chemical odor masking products would not be permitted.

decisions.decision: Abutter notification for marijuana applications set at 300 feet (board consensus).
decisions.quote: board consensus was to go with 300 feet.

decisions.decision: Language to be cleaned up for differing buffers for schools, municipal active recreation, child care, family child care, houses of worship and funeral homes, measured from the marijuana structure to the property line of the protected use.
decisions.quote: language will be cleaned up for differing buffers for schools, municipal active recreation facilities

decisions.decision: Buffer for cultivation in O, RA and RB set at 375 feet (board consensus).
decisions.quote: board consensus was 375 feet in o, ra and rb.

decisions.decision: Majority of the board agreed to a 20 acre minimum for the use.
decisions.quote: the majority of board members were in agreement with a 20 acre minimum.

decisions.decision: Public hearing on the marijuana draft bylaw to be scheduled for the February 25, 2019 Board meeting.
decisions.quote: the public hearing will be scheduled for the board's february 25, 2019 meeting.
